fact: In June 2026 the Libreville-Owendo-Akanda regional health directorate trained ward heads and data managers of public, private and faith-based facilities in the three university hospitals to collect and transmit health data through DHIS2, following April 2026 national data validation that found shortcomings.
title: Renforcement des capacités en gestion des données sanitaires : les majors et gestionnaires de données formés à l’utilisation du DHIS2
